_comment: Exceptions to scripts/check-secrets.mjs. Each entry names a tracked file that carries a credential-shaped literal, and says why. Removing the literal removes the need for the entry — the gate reports an entry whose file no longer matches as stale, so this list cannot accumulate exceptions nobody looks at.

exceptions.portal/wrangler.jsonc: DEMO_BROWSER_API_KEY — a browser key (pk_*), which is a public identifier by design: origin-allowlisted and daily-capped, never a secret. It is here because rotating it requires the Cloudflare secret store, which needs an operator with credentials; the procedure is docs/ops/demo-browser-key-rotation.md. Move it to `wrangler secret put DEMO_BROWSER_API_KEY` and delete this entry when that is done.
